signals.title: Invoice exception pocket requires review
signals.summary: Coupa-style controls show 4.9% invoice exception rate on platform support invoices, above the 3.0% tolerance, driven by 17 missing PO references.
signals.aiExplanation: Invoice exception rate and PO-reference gaps reduce Score & Value until corrected.

signals.title: Platform incident MTTR improves
signals.summary: Mean time to resolve P2 platform incidents improved from 9.4 hours to 6.8 hours, while repeat incident count reduced from 11 to 5 over the same monthly window.
signals.aiExplanation: MTTR improvement and repeat incident reduction strengthen Integration.

signals.title: Digital operations SLA consistently above target
signals.summary: Cognizant India delivered 98.6% operations SLA attainment across 61 queues, exceeding the 97.0% threshold for three consecutive months.
signals.aiExplanation: Sustained SLA over target strengthens Performance.

signals.title: Attrition in specialist pod remains elevated
signals.summary: Specialist engineering pod attrition is 18.5% annualized versus a 12.0% target, with replacement lead time averaging 32 days for automation engineers.
signals.aiExplanation: High attrition and replacement lead time affect continuity and Performance.

signals.title: Automation delivery improves ticket effort
signals.summary: Wipro automation release reduced manual L2 ticket handling by 22% across the pilot queue, saving an estimated 118 analyst hours in the last 30 days.
signals.aiExplanation: Quantified effort reduction improves Score & Value.

signals.title: Engineering capacity fill rate below plan
signals.summary: Wipro filled 18 of 25 requested engineering roles within the 21-day SLA, a 72% fill rate versus the 85% target; four open roles are in API and automation skill areas.
signals.aiExplanation: Fill-rate gap and niche skill shortages reduce Market Fit for specialist delivery.

signals.title: Knowledge-transfer completion improves
signals.summary: Capgemini India completed 86% of planned knowledge-transfer artifacts, up from 71% last month, reducing single-person dependency count from 12 to 6 services.
signals.aiExplanation: Reduced dependency count lowers operational risk exposure.

signals.title: Workplace support CSAT below target
signals.summary: Internal CSAT sampling for workplace support scored 3.8/5.0 against a 4.2 target across 146 responses, with recurring comments on turnaround time for access and device requests.
signals.aiExplanation: CSAT shortfall affects Performance and may require operational remediation.

signals.title: Application support backlog within tolerance
signals.summary: Capgemini India closed 428 support tickets this month with 93.4% within SLA against a 92.0% threshold; aged backlog older than 10 days fell from 31 to 18 tickets.
signals.aiExplanation: Ticket closure volume and SLA compliance support Performance.

signals.title: Cloud cost optimization opportunity identified
signals.summary: FinOps review indicates INR 42 lakh annualized savings potential from reserved capacity and idle-resource cleanup, with 63% of recommendations already technically approved.
signals.aiExplanation: Quantified savings opportunity maps to Score & Value and should be tracked through realization.

signals.title: API uptime remains above service threshold
signals.summary: Integration monitoring shows 99.72% API availability across 18 connected services versus a 99.50% threshold, with P1 incident count stable at zero for the month.
signals.aiExplanation: API availability and incident stability strengthen Integration.

signals.title: Cloud migration sprint behind by 6 days
signals.summary: Accenture India completed 22 of 28 planned cloud migration tasks this sprint; six tasks slipped by an average of 6.1 days, mainly in environment readiness and security sign-off.
signals.aiExplanation: Task completion ratio and average delay reduce Performance until recovery is confirmed.

signals.title: Remediation staffing recovery plan submitted
signals.summary: KPMG India proposed adding 5 FTEs for the remediation pod and reducing backlog aging below 30 days by 31 July 2026; plan requires validation by the vendor owner.
signals.aiExplanation: Recovery staffing plan may improve Market Fit, but confidence remains medium until execution is visible.

signals.title: SLA breach trend over two cycles
signals.summary: Managed compliance operations recorded 91.6% SLA attainment against a 95.0% target for two consecutive months, with 14 late cases and average breach aging of 3.2 business days.
signals.aiExplanation: Repeated SLA underperformance maps to Performance and should trigger owner action.

signals.title: Compliance evidence aging beyond threshold
signals.summary: KPMG India has 7 of 19 compliance evidence items older than 45 days, exceeding the 20% aging threshold; two items relate to access-control review evidence.
signals.aiExplanation: Evidence aging and access-control items create a high-confidence Risk Profile signal.

signals.title: Change-request backlog needs governance
signals.summary: Project controls show 23 open change requests, 9 older than 21 days, with estimated commercial exposure of INR 24 lakh if scope decisions are delayed another cycle.
signals.aiExplanation: Aged change requests and unresolved exposure increase governance and commercial risk.

signals.title: Specialist architecture bench improves
signals.summary: LittleBig-style capacity signal shows 11 certified integration architects available within 14 days, compared with 7 last month, improving specialist capacity coverage from 72% to 91%.
signals.aiExplanation: Certified specialist availability improves Market Fit for specialist delivery.

signals.title: Integration sprint velocity exceeds plan
signals.summary: Deloitte India closed 31 integration user stories against a plan of 27, with API defect leakage at 1.9% versus the 3.0% threshold for the travel platform workstream.
signals.aiExplanation: Sprint velocity and API defect leakage are strong Integration indicators, especially for specialist technology work.

signals.title: Invoice first-pass match improves
signals.summary: Coupa-style invoice controls show first-pass match improved to 94.1% across 312 invoices, reducing manual finance touches by an estimated 37 cases this month.
signals.aiExplanation: Invoice match rate and reduced manual effort improve Score & Value.

signals.title: Tax advisory dependency concentration rising
signals.summary: Internal demand data shows 62% of open tax advisory requests now routed to EY India, up from 48% last quarter, creating concentration exposure for quarter-close support.
signals.aiExplanation: Concentration exposure affects Risk Profile even when service quality remains acceptable.

signals.title: Transformation milestone delivery slightly ahead
signals.summary: EY India completed 14 of 16 transformation milestones on or before planned date, with average slippage reduced to 1.8 days from 4.6 days in the prior quarter.
signals.aiExplanation: Milestone completion rate and reduced slippage strengthen Performance.

signals.title: Rate-card variance requires commercial review
signals.summary: Coupa-style invoice sampling shows 3.4% blended rate-card variance across 186 billed line items, equal to an estimated INR 18.6 lakh quarterly exposure requiring validation before renewal.
signals.aiExplanation: Rate-card variance and estimated exposure map to Score & Value and require commercial validation.

signals.title: Audit remediation cycle improves
signals.summary: PwC India closed 18 of 22 open control remediation actions within the agreed 30-day window, improving closure rate to 81.8% versus 68.5% in the previous review cycle.
signals.aiExplanation: Control closure rate and remediation aging directly affect Risk Profile and audit confidence.

signals.title: Managed services SLA remains above target
signals.summary: PwC India delivered 97.8% monthly SLA attainment against a 96.0% target across 42 tracked advisory and managed-risk work packages; critical overdue items reduced from 6 to 2 month over month.
signals.aiExplanation: SLA attainment, overdue-item reduction and work-package coverage map to PRISM Performance with high confidence.
